sn19.1:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
sn19.1:1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ca lakkhaṇo āyasmā ca mahāmoggallāno gijjhakūṭe pabbate viharanti.
sn19.1:1.4: atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya yenāyasmā lakkhaṇo tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ lakkhaṇaṃ etadavoca:
sn19.1:1.6: evamāvusoti kho āyasmā lakkhaṇo āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa paccassosi.
sn19.1:1.7: atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto aññatarasmiṃ padese sitaṃ pātvākāsi.
sn19.1:1.8: atha kho āyasmā lakkhaṇo āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ etadavoca:
sn19.1:1.9: ko nu kho āvuso moggallāna, hetu ko paccayo sitassa pātukammāyāti?
sn19.1:1.10: akālo kho āvuso lakkhaṇa, etassa pañhassa.
sn19.1:1.11: bhagavato maṃ santike etaṃ pañhaṃ pucchāti.
sn19.1:2.1: atha kho āyasmā ca lakkhaṇo āyasmā ca mahāmoggallāno piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā lakkhaṇo āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ etadavoca:
sn19.1:2.2: idhāyasmā mahāmoggallāno gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto aññatarasmiṃ padese sitaṃ pātvākāsi.
sn19.1:2.3: ko nu kho āvuso moggallāna, hetu ko paccayo sitassa pātukammāyāti?
sn19.1:3.1: idhāhaṃ āvuso, gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto addasaṃ aṭṭhikasaṅkhalikaṃ vehāsaṃ gacchantiṃ.
sn19.1:3.2: tamenaṃ gijjhāpi kākāpi kulalāpi anupatitvā anupatitvā phāsulantarikāhi vitudanti.
sn19.1:3.5: acchariyaṃ vata bho, abbhutaṃ vata bho,
sn19.1:4.3: ñāṇabhūtā vata bhikkhave, sāvakā viharanti, yatra hi nāma sāvako evarūpaṃ ñassati vā dakkhati vā sakkhiṃ vā karissati.
sn19.1:4.4: pubbeva me so bhikkhave, satto diṭṭho ahosi. api cāhaṃ na vyākāsiṃ.
sn19.1:4.5: ahamevetaṃ byākareyyaṃ, pare me na saddaheyyuṃ.
sn19.1:4.6: ye me nasaddaheyyuṃ, tesaṃ taṃ assa dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya.
sn19.1:4.7: eso bhikkhave, satto imasmiṃ yeva rājagahe goghātako ahosi.
sn19.1:4.8: so tassa kammassa vipākena bahūni vassāni bahūni vassasatāni bahūni vassasahassāni bahūni vassasatasahassāni niraye paccitvā tasseva kammassa vipākāvasesena evarūpaṃ attabhāvapaṭilābhaṃ paṭisaṃvedayatīti.
